response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced and versatile software engineer with strong C/C++ background early in his career and relevant geospatial GIS project experience (GISCollective, Green Map), but his recent decade of work has centered on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and web development, not modern C++/Rust or distributed routing/navigation systems. The role requires deep, current C++/Rust expertise and distributed-systems fault-tolerance work that is not evidenced in his recent history.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Strong generalist engineering background across many stacks including C/C++ and Linux
Demonstrated experience with high-throughput, low-latency microservices (Dunnhumby) showing distributed-systems exposure
concerns: No recent (last 5+ years) hands-on C++ or Rust development experience
No direct experience with routing tiles, navigation guidance pipelines, or real-time traffic data integration
Current role (re:cinq) and most recent decade focus on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack work, a mismatch with the core C++/Rust requirement
